result.inputs: final scores and dates of past matches
result.public: yes, provisional: scores are facts also supplied by football-data.org; parity measured below

goals.inputs: final scores (goals for and against) plus league goal rate
goals.public: yes, provisional: same score-only inputs as result

btts.inputs: final scores plus league both-teams-scored rate
btts.public: yes, provisional: same score-only inputs as result

corners.inputs: corner counts per match (football-data.co.uk statistics only)
corners.public: NO: research-only, no permitted source of corner counts

cards.inputs: yellow-card counts per match (football-data.co.uk statistics only)
cards.public: NO: research-only, no permitted source of card counts

shots.inputs: shots-on-target counts per match (football-data.co.uk statistics only)
shots.public: NO: research-only, no permitted source of shot counts
